#

#   go run testdata/mktreehash.go > testdata/treehash.txt

# === Padding-sensitive ordering ===

# Keys whose ordering depends on the padding pattern 00 FF FF FF...
# K={AB} pads as AB 00 FF FF...
# K||00={AB,00} pads as AB 00 00 FF FF...
# K||00||FF={AB,00,FF} pads as AB 00 FF 00 FF FF...
# K||00||FE={AB,00,FE} pads as AB 00 FE 00 FF FF...
# K||01={AB,01} pads as AB 01 00 FF FF...
# Sorted order: K||00 < K||00||FE < K||00||FF < K < K||01

# All five keys together.
kv ab 01
kv ab00 02
kv ab00fe 04
kv ab00ff 03
kv ab01 05

# K||00||FF vs K: K||00||FF < K because padding 0x00 at len(short) < padding 0xFF.
